company.name: FarEye
company.shortDescription: FarEye is a low-code, Intelligent Delivery Management Platform designed for a better delivery experience for everyone.
company.description: FarEye’s AI-powered functionality optimizes end-to-end deliveries and provides recommendations driven by aggregation of insights. It empowers enterprises to gain real-time visibility, excel in the last mile, and deliver customer delight. FarEye has the vision to use aggregated data and real-time feedback to drive autonomous deliveries with autonomous vehicles and drones.  With 17 Gartner mentions, DHL, Hilti, UPS, Gordon Foods, Zalora, and 150 plus customers have laid trust in FarEye as their partner of choice across 30 countries. FarEye is empowering global enterprises to shrink delivery time by up to 27%, increase courier productivity by up to 15%, eliminate risks by up to 57%, and ensure operational excellence
